About the Event:

Null Origin is a Capture The Flag (CTF) competition designed to challenge and enhance participants' cybersecurity skills through real-world scenarios and hands-on problem-solving. Participants will face challenges across multiple domains, testing their technical expertise, analytical thinking, and creativity.

Whether you're a beginner exploring cybersecurity or an experienced hacker looking for a challenge, Null Origin provides a competitive platform to learn, compete, and grow.

Challenge Categories:

  • Web Security
  • Cryptography
  • Reverse Engineering
  • Digital Forensics
  • OSINT
  • Binary Exploitation
  • Miscellaneous Challenges

Event Details:

Mode: Online

Duration: 24 Hours

Team Size: 1-4 Members ( Including Team Leader )

Date: Will be revealed soon.

Eligibility:

  • Open to students, professionals, and cybersecurity enthusiasts from all backgrounds.

Rules:

  • Participants must follow ethical hacking practices.
  • Attacking the competition infrastructure is strictly prohibited.
  • Flag sharing between teams is not allowed.
  • Any form of unfair advantage may lead to disqualification.
  • Organizers' decisions will be final and binding.

Rewards:

  • Rewards:

    Participants will have the opportunity to win exciting prizes and rewards from our official partners, including OffSec and INE.

    More reward announcements are coming soon — we've got something really special for you!

For queries and support:

  • Official E-mail : nullorigin@cyberhx.com

Ready to Trace the Unknown?

  • Join Null Origin and prove your skills where every flag tells a story and every challenge reveals a new attack surface.
